title: Three-axis Inertial Measurement Unit
text: Implement three-axis inertial measurement unit (IMU), 5 inputs, 2 outputs; {Units}, {IMU location}, {Update rate}, {Second order dynamics for accelerometer} sets the second-order, {Accelerometer natural frequency (rad/sec)}, {Accelerometer damping ratio}, {Accelerometer scale factor and cross-coupling} scales factor and cross coupling, {Accelerometer measurement bias}, {Accelerometer upper and lower limits} sets the minimum, {Second-order dynamics for gyro} sets the gyroscope, {Gyro natural frequency (rad/sec)} sets the gyroscope, {Gyro damping ratio} sets the gyroscope, {Gyro scale factors and cross-coupling} sets the gyroscope scale factors and cross-coupling {Gyro measurement bias} sets the gyroscope measurement bias, {G-sensitive bias} sets the maximum change in rates, {Gyro upper and lower limits} sets the minimum and maximum values of angular rates, {Noise on} sets the white noise, {Noise seeds} and {Noise power}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: CG
ports.summary: Location of center of gravity three-element vector
